asked.item: Facebook Page missing from the Duplicate account list
Whether a step is missing, and how to get the same automation on the Facebook Page

verdict.reason: The duplicate rule limits copies to the same platform, and the create steps cover starting a new flow for a Facebook Page.

steps.text: You aren't missing a step. You may only duplicate to accounts on the same platform.
To run one on your Facebook Page, click New automation and pick the connected Facebook Page.
